notes: Giddel was an ancestor of a group of Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Gideon
meaning: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.
notes: Gideon, also called Jerubbaal or Jerubbesheth, was a judge of Israel who, with God's help, defeated the Midianites and delivered Israel from oppression.

name: Gideoni
meaning: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus.
notes: Gideoni, the son of Abidan, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

name: Gilalai
meaning: Priest and musician during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
notes: Gilalai was a priest and musician who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Gilead
meaning: Descendant of Manasseh; son of Michael; father of Jaroah.
notes: Gilead, a descendant of Manasseh, was the son of Michael and the father of Jaroah, as recorded in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad.

name: Gilead
meaning: Father of Jephthah, a judge of Israel.
notes: Gilead was the father of Jephthah, a mighty warrior and judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites.

name: Gilead
meaning: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.
notes: Gilead was the son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh, and father of six sons who became the heads of Gileadite clans.

name: Ginath
meaning: Father of Tibni, who opposed Omri for kingship.
notes: Ginath was the father of Tibni, who contended with Omri for the throne of Israel.

name: Ginnethon
meaning: A priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.
notes: Ginnethon, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's reforms.

name: Girgashite
meaning: A Canaanite people group living in the Promised Land.
notes: The Girgashites were one of the Canaanite groups inhabiting the land promised to Abraham's descendants.

name: Girzites
meaning: A people group David raided while living among the Philistines.
notes: The Girzites were a people group David raided during his time living in Philistine territory.

name: Gishpa
meaning: An overseer of the temple servants during Nehemiah's time.
notes: Gishpa was an overseer of the temple servants (Nethinim) during Nehemiah's time.

name: Gizonites
meaning: A people group mentioned in the Old Testament.
notes: The Gizonites are mentioned in 1Ch.11.34 without any additional context.

name: Gog
meaning: A descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.
notes: Gog, a descendant of Reuben, is mentioned in the genealogy of Reuben in 1Ch.5.4 .

name: Goiim
meaning: A king of Goyim who fought alongside Chedorlaomer.
notes: Tidal, king of Goiim (nations), was one of the kings who fought alongside Chedorlaomer in Genesis 14.

name: Goliath
meaning: A Philistine giant defeated by David.
notes: Goliath was the Philistine champion from Gath who was defeated by David in a battle.

name: Gomer
meaning: Son of Japheth; father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
notes: Gomer, a son of Japheth, was the father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah, as listed in the Table of Nations.

name: Gomer
meaning: Hosea's wife, a promiscuous woman.
notes: Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, was the wife of the prophet Hosea.

name: Guni
meaning: A descendant of Gad; father of Abdiel.
notes: Guni, a descendant of Gad, was the father of Abdiel, as mentioned in the genealogy of Gad.

name: Guni
meaning: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob.
notes: Guni was a son of Naphtali and a grandson of Jacob, as listed in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

name: Haahashtari
meaning: A descendant of Judah through Hezron.
notes: Haahashtari was a descendant of Judah through Hezron, as listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

name: Habaiah
meaning: A priest whose descendants were unable to prove their lineage.
notes: Habaiah was a priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood due to insufficient genealogical records.

name: Habakkuk
meaning: A prophet who questioned God's justice.
notes: Habakkuk, a prophet, wrote the book bearing his name, which records his dialogue with God about justice and faith.

name: Habazziniah
meaning: Grandfather of Jaazaniah, a Rechabite leader.
notes: Habazziniah was the grandfather of Jaazaniah, a leader of the Rechabites during Jeremiah's time.

name: Hacaliah
meaning: Father of Nehemiah, the governor of Judah.
notes: Hacaliah was the father of Nehemiah, who served as the governor of Judah during the Persian period.

name: Hachmoni
meaning: Father of Jehiel, one of David's family servants.
notes: Hachmoni was the father of Jehiel who, with Jonathan attended King David's sons.

name: Hachmonite
meaning: A clan or family known for their mighty warriors.
notes: The Hachmonites, also known as the Tahchemonites, were a clan or family that produced some of David's mighty warriors.

name: Hadad
meaning: An Edomite prince who opposed Solomon.
notes: Hadad, an Edomite prince, fled to Egypt and later became an adversary to King Solomon.

name: Hadad
meaning: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.
notes: Hadad was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son.

name: Hadad
meaning: King of Edom, succeeded Husham.
notes: Hadad, son of Bedad, became king of Edom after Husham's death.

name: Hadad
meaning: The last king of Edom before Israelite rule.
notes: Hadad, also known as Hadar, was the last king of Edom before the Israelites established their monarchy.

name: Hadadezer
meaning: King of Zobah, defeated by David.
notes: Hadadezer, king of Zobah, was defeated by King David in battle, and his allies, the Arameans, became subject to Israel.

name: Hadlai
meaning: Father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah.
notes: Hadlai was the father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

name: Hadoram
meaning: Son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem.
notes: Hadoram was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hagab
meaning: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
notes: Hagab was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity, as recorded in Ezra.

name: Hagabah
meaning: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
notes: Hagabah, also known as Hagaba, was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Hagar
meaning: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.
notes: Hagar, Sarah's Egyptian maidservant, bore Abraham a son named Ishmael and is also mentioned in Paul's allegory in Galatians.

name: Haggai
meaning: A prophet who encouraged the rebuilding of the temple.
notes: Haggai, a prophet during the post-exilic period, urged the people to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Haggedolim
meaning: A priest mentioned in Nehemiah's time.
notes: Haggedolim was a priest during the time of Nehemiah, mentioned in the list of priests and Levites.

name: Haggi
meaning: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob.
notes: Haggi was a son of Gad and a grandson of Jacob, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

name: Haggiah
meaning: A Levite, descendant of Merari.
notes: Haggiah, a Levite descended from Merari, is mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites in 1 Chronicles.
